conversion: Original bounded OSM API XML plus three complete forest relations converted to forest-only Overpass-compatible geometry. All original XML is retained. Relation member chains are polygonized with inner rings subtracted; no simplification.
mapped_attributes: Natural wood/landuse forest outlines and interior clearings. Leaf type/cycle used where tagged; unspecified stands remain explicit inferred mixed woodland. Current mapping may postdate the supplied game reference. OSM canopy outlines are not a surveyed individual-tree inventory.
placement: Clip each original polygon to the classified-ground terrain grid and preserve its clearings. Exclude the complete road, protection and apron corridor, every mapped building, water and the existing authored temporary stands, with a 12 m safety buffer. Place trees in jittered 12 m cells at least 5 m inside each woodland polygon. Road geometry, protection, runoff and all measured ground heights remain unchanged.

tree_estimates.uncertainty: Tree positions, heights and untagged species proportions remain original reconstruction inside actual mapped woodland. Seeded height variation removes the previous uniform12m dwarf edge. Evergreen crown width narrows at mapped edges while preserving mature height; broadleaf crown height remains constrained to clearings. No new forest or clearing removal.

geometry_budget: Preserve mature tree silhouettes throughout the visible slopes. Detailed trees extend250m from every road station. Every evergreen has a grounded trunk and8–18 tapered foliage whorls; distant broadleaf uses complete rooted tree silhouettes. Geometry is partitioned through the existing400000triangle perasset limit. The former600000triangle authoring target no longer justifies suspended low-detail crowns in visible scenery.

reference.observation: Continuous densely wooded banks/ridges with mixed canopy edges and real open grass/spectator clearings. Prior sparse parallel rows leave artificial bare bands.
reference.registration: Middle-sector landscape context only. Exact corner and pose are not registered; do not infer tree coordinates or road dimensions from this still.

temporary_stand_clearings.geometry: Original authored stand parameters and seat geometry are unchanged. Their exact swept seating envelope excludes tree crowns locally; no new physical corridor or terrain cut is added.
